info.title: LMS Billing Service
info.description: Quotes, GST invoices, payments, credit notes and employer job-post plans (docs/PRODUCT.md §5.10): money in integer paise, gap-free numbering per financial year, issued invoices immutable (corrections are credit notes), manual payments always available, the payment gateway a contract only.
